name: Data analytics
description: Question -> scoped query -> analyze -> chart -> review. A generated query is never a result: this pack requires a query file AND a result file produced by a command that exited 0.
requiredResult: Query, results, chart, assumptions, reproducible report

steps.title: Scope the query for: {{question}}
steps.instructions: Write the query that answers {{question}} to analysis/query.sql and list your assumptions in analysis/assumptions.md. Do not report any numbers in this step: nothing has been executed yet.

steps.title: Execute the query and analyze: {{question}}
steps.instructions: Execute analysis/query.sql against the configured read-only database or data file and write the output to analysis/results.csv. The command you run must name analysis/query.sql so the execution is recorded. Report the row count and the exit code. If the query cannot be executed here, say so and stop: an unexecuted query is not a result.
steps.deliverable: analysis/results.csv produced by a recorded command that exited 0

steps.title: Chart the executed results for: {{question}}
steps.instructions: Write analysis/chart.(js|py) that reads analysis/results.csv and produces analysis/chart.svg or .png, then run it. Charts are built from the executed results file only, never from numbers in a message.
steps.deliverable: analysis/chart.* plus the script that produced it

steps.title: Review the analysis for: {{question}}
steps.instructions: Check that analysis/query.sql was executed (a recorded command with exit code 0), that analysis/results.csv exists, that the chart was generated from it, and that assumptions are listed. Write analysis/report.md and finish with JSON matching the output schema. Set executed to false when no execution was recorded.

executed.description: True only when a recorded command running the query exited 0

rubric.criterion: A generated query is not a result
rubric.howMeasured: The analyze step requires command-exit-zero:analysis/query.sql AND a file edit under analysis/results
rubric.failsWhen: analysis/query.sql exists but no recorded command running it reported exit code 0 - the pack has failed, whatever the report says

rubric.criterion: The result file came from that execution
rubric.howMeasured: analysis/results.csv was edited in the same step whose command matched the query file
rubric.failsWhen: results.csv was written with no recorded execution command

rubric.criterion: The chart was rendered from the result file
rubric.howMeasured: A recorded command matching chart/plot/render exited 0 and a file edit under analysis/chart is recorded
rubric.failsWhen: The chart file appears with no generating command, or is drawn from numbers quoted in a message

rubric.howMeasured: analysis/assumptions.md exists and the assumptions array is non-empty
rubric.failsWhen: The report states a number with no assumption list

rubric.howMeasured: reportFile, queryFile, resultFile, and chartFile are all recorded paths and every one names its command
rubric.failsWhen: Any of the four is missing, so the analysis cannot be re-run from the record

sampleInputs.question: Which providers have the highest retry rate?

notes: requiredConnectors lists sql-database, which is NOT implemented in this build: there is no SQL connector, so queries run through the shell tool against a read-only client or a local data file, and the workspace policy decides whether that command is allowed. executed:false is a valid, honest outcome - it is never a pass.
